definitions: A row of houses built in a similar style and joined together, sharing side walls.
A raised, flat mound of earth with sloping sides, especially one of a series of such mounds forming a garden or part of a landscape.
A paved outdoor area next to a house, serving as an outdoor living space; a patio.
A flat roof or part of a roof that is used as an outdoor living area.
A section of seating in a sports stadium, typically uncovered and without individual seats, where spectators stand.
examples: They live in a lovely Victorian terrace.
The rice paddies were built on terraces.
We had drinks on the terrace overlooking the sea.
The stadium's north terrace was packed.
The house has several terraces for outdoor entertaining.
